author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices keyboard landmarks, a returning answer line, A-A-B song form, moving the hand, counting bars of four and two-hand teamwork, with an old carol.

classes.title: The king's hand: G to D
classes.goal: Place the right thumb on low G, below C, and learn the first line.

mathTarget.parentLine: Find C first, then step down three white keys to G

classes.parentPrompt: Find C with your child, then step down three white keys together to G for the thumb.
classes.childAction: Find C, walk down to G, thumb on G. Finger 4 lands on C.
classes.bridge: C is the castle door; the king's thumb steps out three keys to the left.

intro.caption: Find the castle door: C
intro.parentCue: point to C, then walk down to G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding G by counting down from C.

classes.title: The answer comes back
classes.goal: Learn the answer line that comes back again and again in the carol.

mathTarget.parentLine: One answer line comes back three times in the song

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one finger each time the answer line starts: one, two, three.
classes.childAction: Play A, G, A, B, C, C. Count how often it comes back.
classes.bridge: The answer climbs back up the steps from G to the castle door, C.

intro.caption: Learn the answer line
intro.parentCue: count on your fingers each time it returns

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting a line that repeats.

classes.title: Same, same, then the moon
classes.goal: Play the whole carol slowly and hear the music repeat, then change.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same music twice, then something new

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'A' when the first music starts, 'A again' when it repeats, and 'B!' at the moon.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and call out A, A, then B!
classes.bridge: Part A walks the snow twice; part B looks up high at the moon.

intro.caption: A, A, and then B
intro.parentCue: call out each part as it starts

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing A, A, B song form.

classes.title: Move up for the moon
classes.goal: Practise moving the hand up to C so finger 5 can reach the high G.

mathTarget.parentLine: The whole hand slides up; the fingers keep their shape

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child lift the whole hand and land the thumb on C. Go slowly.
classes.childAction: Slide your hand up: thumb on C. Then play the moon line.
classes.bridge: The hand walks up the hill to the right to see the bright moon.

intro.caption: Slide up to see the moon
intro.parentCue: lift the whole hand, thumb lands on C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: moving the hand to a new place.

classes.title: Low notes on one
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note on the first beat of each bar of four.

mathTarget.parentLine: Count four beats; the low note always lands on one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and count 'one, two, three, four' out loud, loudest on one.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays one low note on every one. Then wait.
classes.bridge: Low notes live on the left: the king's big boots, one step per bar.

games.caption: C high, C low: same name
games.parentCue: Point high, then low, with each sound

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting bars of four, landing on one.

classes.title: Slow boots, busy hand
classes.goal: Play the tune with one low note per bar: one hand waits while the other moves.

mathTarget.parentLine: One long low note while four tune notes walk above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'boot' on each low note. Go very slowly.
classes.childAction: Left hand holds the low note while the right hand walks.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the king's slow boot in the snow; right hand walks four steps.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: both hands on the keys, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two different jobs.

classes.title: A little faster, together
classes.goal: Play both hands a little faster, and slow down again if notes fall apart.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same notes, same order, only the speed goes up

classes.parentPrompt: Tap a slightly faster beat on your knee; if notes fall apart, go back to slow.
classes.childAction: Play both hands a bit faster. Too fast? Slow down, no problem.
classes.bridge: The king walks a bit quicker through the snow, still in the same footsteps.

intro.caption: A little faster, together
intro.parentCue: slow down any time it gets messy

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same music at a faster speed.

classes.title: Sing out with the carol
classes.goal: Play the whole carol along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the words beside your child; if notes are missed, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep walking!
classes.bridge: The tune is over 400 years old; now your fingers walk with it.

intro.caption: Walk along with the music
intro.parentCue: sing the words softly beside your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music.

classes.title: A carol for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole carol for teddy and hear each question line find its answer.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first line stops on G; its answer comes home to C

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; hold the very last C long, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play to the end, hold the last C, and take a bow.
classes.bridge: G is the open castle door; C is home by the warm fire.

intro.caption: A carol for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a whole song of questions and answers.
